newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Murchison sees mine positive in 97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Murchison sees mine positive in 97.

text.p: Murchison United NL said on Monday it expected its Mt Cuthbert copper project in north west Queensland to generate positive cash flows from early 1997.
Murchison managing director Paul Atherley said in a statement 90,000 tonnes of high grade copper ore had so far been mined, crushed and stacked and was currently under leach.
The A$11.6 million development, a joint venture between Murchison (60 percent) and Brancote Australia NL (40 percent) was completed on budget in just over eight months, he said.
Heap leach performance had been excellent with high percolation rates and copper solution grades achieving design, Atherley said.

"With operating costs forecast at US$0.69 per pound and with 80 percent of 1997 production hedged at an average of US$1.06, Mt Cuthbert is expected to generate positive cashflows for Murchison from early 1997," he said.
Initial mine life exceeds five years with production planned to be increased by 50 percent to 8,250 tonnnes per year during 1997, he said.

Atherley said Murchison had begun exploration on the 90 km strike length of the highly mineralised Mt Remarkable-St Paul shear zone, and early results from the Standby prospect east of the Mt Cuthbert plant had been encouraging.
